title: ReEval: Automatic Hallucination Evaluation for Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models via Transferable Adversarial Attacks
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating LLM hallucination and faithfulness to provided evidence to ensure 'trustworthy and safe AI'.
